Mark.name: Mark
Mark.description: One unit of Glowhaven currency. Quotes, wages, and debts use marks. An item payout and a displayed money total describe the same holdings, never two separate payments.

Packed Lunch.name: Packed Lunch
Packed Lunch.description: A practical wrapped meal, commonly 3 marks. Food rather than a universal healing effect.

Clean Bandages.name: Clean Bandages
Clean Bandages.description: Clean dressings, commonly 5 marks. Applying them to an appropriate minor injury restores 8 health once; they do not revive the dead or repair lasting damage.

Standard Healing Draught.name: Standard Healing Draught
Standard Healing Draught.description: A labeled common healing preparation, normally 25 marks. Drinking one restores 25 health once. It does not reverse aging, restore all lasting injuries, or replace treatment of a severe condition.

Calibration Chalk.name: Calibration Chalk
Calibration Chalk.description: Nonconductive marking chalk for supervised focus tests. A small packet costs 6 marks. A marked diagram does not automatically cast its intended spell.

Replacement Conduit Collar.name: Replacement Conduit Collar
Replacement Conduit Collar.description: A fitted conducting collar for an appropriate household focus, commonly 18 marks. Its size and compatibility must match the device.

Insulated Test Lead.name: Insulated Test Lead
Insulated Test Lead.description: A reusable insulated test lead for low-output supervised diagnostics, commonly 12 marks. It does not make an unsafe experiment harmless.

Simple Casting Wand.name: Simple Casting Wand
Simple Casting Wand.description: A reliable ordinary control catalyst made with mana-bearing material, commonly 60 marks in Glowhaven. It helps the user feel and direct mana for spells actually learned; no external reserve, new affinity or free mastery is included.

Household Enchanted Lamp.name: Household Enchanted Lamp
Household Enchanted Lamp.description: A dependable low-output lamp, commonly 80 marks. It supplies ordinary illumination when correctly maintained, not combat Light magic.

Fragrance Sample.name: Fragrance Sample
Fragrance Sample.description: A labeled small scent sample, normally 8 marks. Intended for testing scent and compatibility, with no mind-reading or compelled attraction.

Workshop Gloves.name: Workshop Gloves
Workshop Gloves.description: Practical work gloves, commonly 8 marks. Useful for suitable tasks but not proof against fire, blades, or unknown reagents.

Survey Rope.name: Survey Rope
Survey Rope.description: A sound general-purpose rope, commonly 12 marks. A safe anchor and actual load assessment are still necessary.

Specimen Case.name: Specimen Case
Specimen Case.description: A small labeled protective case, commonly 10 marks. Ownership and safe collection still matter.

Repair Receipt.name: Repair Receipt
Repair Receipt.description: A receipt recording an actual customer's item, agreed scope, price, deposit, and status. Blank possession proves no ownership or paid debt.

Case Record Copy.name: Case Record Copy
Case Record Copy.description: An authorized copy of an actually identified case entry. A copy normally costs 2 marks and cannot create a verdict or discharge by itself.

Custody Property Receipt.name: Custody Property Receipt
Custody Property Receipt.description: An intake receipt listing belongings actually deposited and their custody location. It preserves the right to claim those belongings; it is not a key.

Prison Work Order.name: Prison Work Order
Prison Work Order.description: A genuine work order naming its holder, duties, access limits, supervision, and pay or credit. It grants only the actual authorized assignment.

Discharge Warrant.name: Discharge Warrant
Discharge Warrant.description: An authenticated release authority tied to a specific person and actual case. Finding a blank or another person's document does not release the holder.

Plain Casting Staff.name: Plain Casting Staff
Plain Casting Staff.description: A plain wooden staff prepared from mana-bearing material as a control catalyst. It assists actual learned spells without an external mana reserve. Physical staff work still depends on training; it grants neither new magic nor automatic combat mastery.

Student Grimoire.name: Student Grimoire
Student Grimoire.description: A bound record of the owner's introductory spell blueprints, with a prepared mana-bearing binding usable as a familiar catalyst. Its notes can assist memory, but no new discipline is learned merely by owning it. The binding supplies no external reserve.

Practice Blade.name: Practice Blade
Practice Blade.description: A plain blunted steel training blade in a simple scabbard. Suitable for supervised practice and basic trained blade work, with no enchantment or numerical bonus. Actual Force, Finesse, or Guarded technique governs its use; it is not a lethal sharp weapon merely because the owner calls it one.

Training Shield.name: Training Shield
Training Shield.description: A plain reinforced wooden training shield with a fitted grip. It supports actual guarded fighting, cover, and trained shield contact. It does not automatically absorb spells, return energy, grant a passive damage reduction, or supply a free counterattack.

Padded Handwraps.name: Padded Handwraps
Padded Handwraps.description: Ordinary padded wraps for trained punches, grappling practice, and protection from minor abrasion. They contain no enchantment and add no automatic damage, armor bonus, mana, or knowledge. Hand casting still requires actual learned control.

Admission Packet - Phoenix Wing.name: Admission Packet - Phoenix Wing
Admission Packet - Phoenix Wing.description: An acceptance packet confirming admission to Phoenix Wing Academy. It includes the route to the registrar's timetable desk and the first-year welcome. It is not an application awaiting another approval.

Appointment Letter - Phoenix Wing.name: Appointment Letter - Phoenix Wing
Appointment Letter - Phoenix Wing.description: An accepted instructor's appointment at Phoenix Wing Academy. The headmaster's induction supplies the teaching subject, assigned room and first-bell start on the following morning. It confirms employment, not command over colleagues or permission to enter restricted facilities.

Admission Packet - Gryffin Tail.name: Admission Packet - Gryffin Tail
Admission Packet - Gryffin Tail.description: An acceptance packet confirming admission to Gryffin Tail Academy. It includes the route to the registrar's timetable desk and the first-year welcome. It is not an application awaiting another approval.

Appointment Letter - Gryffin Tail.name: Appointment Letter - Gryffin Tail
Appointment Letter - Gryffin Tail.description: An accepted instructor's appointment at Gryffin Tail Academy. The headmaster's induction supplies the teaching subject, assigned room and first-bell start on the following morning. It confirms employment, not command over colleagues or permission to enter restricted facilities.

Admission Packet - Dragon Hoard.name: Admission Packet - Dragon Hoard
Admission Packet - Dragon Hoard.description: An acceptance packet confirming admission to Dragon Hoard Academy. It includes the route to the registrar's timetable desk and the first-year welcome. It is not an application awaiting another approval.

Appointment Letter - Dragon Hoard.name: Appointment Letter - Dragon Hoard
Appointment Letter - Dragon Hoard.description: An accepted instructor's appointment at Dragon Hoard Academy. The headmaster's induction supplies the teaching subject, assigned room and first-bell start on the following morning. It confirms employment, not command over colleagues or permission to enter restricted facilities.

Admission Packet - Hydra Head.name: Admission Packet - Hydra Head
Admission Packet - Hydra Head.description: An acceptance packet confirming admission to Hydra Head Academy. It includes the route to the registrar's timetable desk and the first-year welcome. It is not an application awaiting another approval.

Appointment Letter - Hydra Head.name: Appointment Letter - Hydra Head
Appointment Letter - Hydra Head.description: An accepted instructor's appointment at Hydra Head Academy. The headmaster's induction supplies the teaching subject, assigned room and first-bell start on the following morning. It confirms employment, not command over colleagues or permission to enter restricted facilities.

Drakenspire Portal Key.name: Drakenspire Portal Key
Drakenspire Portal Key.description: A reusable transit key for the active Evertree route to Drakenspire Mountains. Use it in Evertree Base's Portal Room to open the route to Drakenspire's Portal Room. It records an issued passage; carrying it does not grant access to other palace rooms or private places at the destination. Issued only by the court or its explicit delegate for an approved reason such as enrolled study, authorized trade, court duty or credible noble sponsorship. Ownership claims, social status and a friendly unofficial handover do not create court permission.

Asterveil Portal Key.name: Asterveil Portal Key
Asterveil Portal Key.description: A reusable transit key for the active Evertree route to Asterveil Sky Archipelago. Use it in Evertree Base's Portal Room to open the route to Cloudbloom Landing's Portal Room. It records an issued passage; passengers do not need to cast the portal. Issued only by the court or its explicit delegate for an approved reason such as enrolled study, authorized trade, court duty or credible noble sponsorship. Ownership claims, social status and a friendly unofficial handover do not create court permission.

Silver Web Portal Key.name: Silver Web Portal Key
Silver Web Portal Key.description: A reusable silver-threaded key that mysteriously condenses on the first arrival inside the Silken Descent's ruined portal room. It records the discovered passage and its stable home connection. At Evertree Base - Portal Room, use it to open the matching arch back to the Silken Portal Room. The discovered return arch leads home freely even without the key. The key is retained after use and does not prove descent, matron defeat or expedition credit.

Glowhaven Portal Key.name: Glowhaven Portal Key
Glowhaven Portal Key.description: A reusable court-issued return key provided under the traveler's approved Evertree passage. At Drakenspire - Portal Room or Cloudbloom Landing - Portal Room, use it to return directly to Evertree Base - Portal Room in Glowhaven. It can also identify the home connection at a return arch already discovered in actual play. It is retained after use, costs no passenger mana and does not open a portal elsewhere. Fixed return arches also work without it. The key grants no private palace access or new outbound authorization.

Asterveil Field Atlas.name: Asterveil Field Atlas
Asterveil Field Atlas.description: A working atlas of Cloudbloom Reaches, Rimeglass Heights, Mirrorwater Marches and Amethyst Crown. It identifies public approaches, landing points and progressively more dangerous country. It does not reveal hidden inner sites, prove a route is currently safe or grant travel permission. Commonly sold for 20 marks.

Asterveil Survey Kit.name: Asterveil Survey Kit
Asterveil Survey Kit.description: A practical kit of marked cord, folding sight, sample labels, sealed jars and a compact weather notebook. It supports actual observation and careful collection. It grants no universal skill, success bonus, flight or protection. Commonly 120 marks; actual purchase or loan is required.

Discharged Stormglass Plate.name: Discharged Stormglass Plate
Discharged Stormglass Plate.description: A real spent plate from a Stormglass Kite or an agreed local collection. The discharged condition matters for safe handling. It is a research/crafting component, not a charged weapon, permanent equipment bonus or mana potion.

Mature Glassreed Bundle.name: Mature Glassreed Bundle
Mature Glassreed Bundle.description: A small bundle of properly selected mature glassreed for filters, fine tubing or research. A permitted harvest and safe storage preserve its useful structure. Its hollow stems are easily spoiled by careless cutting or damp storage.

Prismfold Membrane.name: Prismfold Membrane
Prismfold Membrane.description: An intact cast-off membrane from a Prismfold Fan, kept flat for optical comparison. Its refractive structure can inform real research. It grants no free Illusion ability, invisibility or infinite material copies.

Stillstar Calibration Component.name: Stillstar Calibration Component
Stillstar Calibration Component.description: A bounded old measuring component from Stillstar Sanctum. Its condition and whether it has actually been removed must be established. It can be studied or recovered under the commission’s terms; naming it does not grant power over Asterveil buoyancy.

Matron's Anchor Sigil.name: Matron's Anchor Sigil
Matron's Anchor Sigil.description: A palm-sized fragment of silver-black metal threaded with hardened silk. Its broken lattice still holds a faint warmth from the arachne matron’s shattered web-anchor—an unsettling keepsake of the Silken Descent.

Guild Badge: Bronze.name: Guild Badge: Bronze
Guild Badge: Bronze.description: A personal Adventurer’s Guild badge bearing the Bronze rank and the branch’s registration seal. Its holder is licensed to accept Bronze contracts and requests of lower rank.

Guild Badge: Silver.name: Guild Badge: Silver
Guild Badge: Silver.description: A personal Adventurer’s Guild badge bearing the Silver rank and the branch’s registration seal. Its holder is licensed to accept Silver contracts and requests of lower rank.

Guild Badge: Gold.name: Guild Badge: Gold
Guild Badge: Gold.description: A personal Adventurer’s Guild badge bearing the Gold rank and the branch’s registration seal. Its holder is licensed to accept Gold contracts and requests of lower rank.

Guild Badge: Platinum.name: Guild Badge: Platinum
Guild Badge: Platinum.description: A personal Adventurer’s Guild badge bearing the Platinum rank and the branch’s registration seal. Its holder is licensed to accept Platinum contracts and requests of lower rank.

Guild Exam Docket.name: Guild Exam Docket
Guild Exam Docket.description: A folded licensure application bearing the Glowhaven branch’s seal, with spaces for the judgment review and practical assessment results.

Guild Judgment Pass.name: Guild Judgment Pass
Guild Judgment Pass.description: A signed assessment slip certifying a satisfactory judgment review: reading a request, recognizing danger and knowing when to withdraw.

Guild Practical Pass.name: Guild Practical Pass
Guild Practical Pass.description: A signed assessment slip certifying a satisfactory practical demonstration of the applicant’s adventuring skills.

Guild Service Credit.name: Guild Service Credit
Guild Service Credit.description: A stamped entry from the guild’s service ledger, recording one completed commission. Entries are collected and filed when an adventurer’s promotion is approved.

Guild Proof: Courier.name: Guild Proof: Courier
Guild Proof: Courier.description: A field record and supporting receipt for “A Parcel for the Bazaar”, ready to be checked and filed at the guild counter.

Guild Proof: Survey.name: Guild Proof: Survey
Guild Proof: Survey.description: A field record and supporting receipt for “Westwood Trail Notes”, ready to be checked and filed at the guild counter.

Guild Proof: Recovery.name: Guild Proof: Recovery
Guild Proof: Recovery.description: A field record and supporting receipt for “Broken Halo Recovery”, ready to be checked and filed at the guild counter.

Guild Proof: Mine.name: Guild Proof: Mine
Guild Proof: Mine.description: A field record and supporting receipt for “Redvein Safety Survey”, ready to be checked and filed at the guild counter.

Guild Proof: Crown.name: Guild Proof: Crown
Guild Proof: Crown.description: A field record and supporting receipt for “Inverted Crown Instruments”, ready to be checked and filed at the guild counter.

First-Year Timetable - Phoenix Wing.name: First-Year Timetable - Phoenix Wing
First-Year Timetable - Phoenix Wing.description: A folded first-year timetable for Phoenix Wing Academy, handed out at its registrar's desk on opening morning. Required lessons run from the first bell to midday; the listed core subjects are Magic Theory — Haruki Saitō; Magical Combat — Ritsu Kurogane; Potions & Alchemy — Ranka Kagari. The opening day's first lesson after the welcome is Magic Theory in the Lecture Hall. Afternoons are normally free unless a specific supervised activity has been announced.

First-Year Timetable - Gryffin Tail.name: First-Year Timetable - Gryffin Tail
First-Year Timetable - Gryffin Tail.description: A folded first-year timetable for Gryffin Tail Academy, handed out at its registrar's desk on opening morning. Required lessons run from the first bell to midday; the listed core subjects are Magic Theory — Kei Aoki; Magical Engineering — Sōichirō Takamine; Magical Arts — Ririka Kujō. The opening day's first lesson after the welcome is Magic Theory in the Lecture Hall. Afternoons are normally free unless a specific supervised activity has been announced.

First-Year Timetable - Dragon Hoard.name: First-Year Timetable - Dragon Hoard
First-Year Timetable - Dragon Hoard.description: A folded first-year timetable for Dragon Hoard Academy, handed out at its registrar's desk on opening morning. Required lessons run from the first bell to midday; the listed core subjects are Magic Theory — Noriaki Takatsuki; Spellcraft — Madoka Narukami; Magical Creatures — Genzō Iwakura. The opening day's first lesson after the welcome is Magic Theory in the Lecture Hall. Afternoons are normally free unless a specific supervised activity has been announced.

First-Year Timetable - Hydra Head.name: First-Year Timetable - Hydra Head
First-Year Timetable - Hydra Head.description: A folded first-year timetable for Hydra Head Academy, handed out at its registrar's desk on opening morning. Required lessons run from the first bell to midday; the listed core subjects are Magic Theory — Kana Fujimoto; Enchantment — Reon Fujisaki; Herbology — Kaoruko Hanazono. The opening day's first lesson after the welcome is Magic Theory in the Lecture Hall. Afternoons are normally free unless a specific supervised activity has been announced.

Wanted Poster.name: Wanted Poster
Wanted Poster.description: A wanted poster with your face on it.

Roadwarden's Sword.name: Roadwarden's Sword
Roadwarden's Sword.description: A plain, sharp steel sword with a brown leather grip and a scabbard patched at the throat. Made for years of ordinary road work.

Riveted Basket Sword.name: Riveted Basket Sword
Riveted Basket Sword.description: A straight sword with a protective basket of crossed steel strips. Its balance rewards a controlled hand rather than a broad swing.

Whitepass Arming Sword.name: Whitepass Arming Sword
Whitepass Arming Sword.description: A mountain-made sword with a short, sturdy guard and a grip that remains secure through winter gloves. The fuller bears a small maker's goat.

Lanternedge.name: Lanternedge
Lanternedge.description: A pale sword whose narrow fuller shines like a covered lantern when its pommel is turned. A sliding brass shutter dims the light for travel.

Common Cavalry Saber.name: Common Cavalry Saber
Common Cavalry Saber.description: A slightly curved steel saber with a simple knucklebow. The scabbard carries the dents of practical manufacture rather than a distinguished campaign.

Copperleaf Cutlass.name: Copperleaf Cutlass
Copperleaf Cutlass.description: A broad cutlass with copper leaves embossed on its guard. Sailors favor its short reach on crowded decks and its easy-to-clean fittings.

Snowchain Saber.name: Snowchain Saber
Snowchain Saber.description: A robust saber with a cord loop at the grip and a fur-lined scabbard mouth. Freight escorts use it on exposed mountain routes.

Emberglass Smile.name: Emberglass Smile
Emberglass Smile.description: A dark saber threaded with amber-red glass. After a flame working, tiny sparks travel along the enclosed channels like insects returning to a hive.

Plain Dueling Rapier.name: Plain Dueling Rapier
Plain Dueling Rapier.description: A slender steel rapier with a modest swept hilt. Its tip is sharp, its finish plain, and its maker has spent the money on the temper.

Blue-Ribbon Rapier.name: Blue-Ribbon Rapier
Blue-Ribbon Rapier.description: A lively rapier with a narrow cyan ribbon tied beneath the guard. The ribbon can be replaced; the careful balance is the reason to buy it.

Three-Ring Estoc.name: Three-Ring Estoc
Three-Ring Estoc.description: A stiff thrusting sword with three steel rings protecting the hand. Its maker has left a neat mark inside the guard where only its owner sees it.

Last Word at Supper.name: Last Word at Supper
Last Word at Supper.description: A silver-finished rapier that gives one delicate dinner-bell note when drawn. The blade is quite real despite its owner's opportunity for an entrance.

Traveler's Greatsword.name: Traveler's Greatsword
Traveler's Greatsword.description: A long, sharp sword meant for two hands, with plain fittings and a broad cloth shoulder sling. It is workmanlike rather than ceremonial.

Hearthforged Greatsword.name: Hearthforged Greatsword
Hearthforged Greatsword.description: A broad two-handed sword with a dark central ridge and a heat-colored guard. Its weight sits close enough to the hands for deliberate recovery.

Avalanche Cleaver.name: Avalanche Cleaver
Avalanche Cleaver.description: A thick-backed greatsword with a squared tip and a deeply textured grip. Mountain mercenaries use its weight without pretending it is light.

The Red Horizon.name: The Red Horizon
The Red Horizon.description: A colossal two-handed sword of dark red steel, its blade marked with a thin gold line from heel to tip. It appears in old descriptions of a battle whose victor was never recorded.

Working Dagger.name: Working Dagger
Working Dagger.description: A sturdy pointed dagger in a plain belt sheath. The rough spine offers a thumb purchase for careful work.

Sleeveguard Dirk.name: Sleeveguard Dirk
Sleeveguard Dirk.description: A long dagger with a secure hand guard and a narrow sheath. Duelists carry it for the space a larger weapon cannot comfortably cover.

Black Thread Stiletto.name: Black Thread Stiletto
Black Thread Stiletto.description: A slim triangular dagger with matte fittings and a tightly retained sheath. It draws without the clatter of loose metal.

The Apologetic Knife.name: The Apologetic Knife
The Apologetic Knife.description: A black dagger that murmurs a little bell-like apology whenever its point clears the sheath. Nobody has found a quieter way to draw it.

Matched Street Blades.name: Matched Street Blades
Matched Street Blades.description: Two short steel blades in a paired belt rig, fitted to be used together. The simple guards leave room for a close, mobile fighting style.

Copperfin Pair.name: Copperfin Pair
Copperfin Pair.description: A matched pair of short curved swords with fish-tail pommels. Their scabbards nest together without rattling.

Rimehook Twins.name: Rimehook Twins
Rimehook Twins.description: Two hooked short blades with heavy guards and winter-wrapped grips. They favor close control over long lunges.

Quarrelsome Sisters.name: Quarrelsome Sisters
Quarrelsome Sisters.description: A pair of dark swords, one etched with a sun and the other with rain. Touching their pommels produces two different, distinctly argumentative notes.

Ashwood Spear.name: Ashwood Spear
Ashwood Spear.description: A straight ash shaft carrying a leaf-shaped steel head. A leather sleeve marks the point where its balance rests.

Ferrywatch Spear.name: Ferrywatch Spear
Ferrywatch Spear.description: A ferryman's long spear with a short crossbar below its point. The butt is capped for purchase on slippery boards.

Goatstep Boar Spear.name: Goatstep Boar Spear
Goatstep Boar Spear.description: A broad hunting spear with a reinforced shaft and stout lugs. Its fittings are easy to replace far from a forge.

Rootwake Lance.name: Rootwake Lance
Rootwake Lance.description: A long spear with living-looking root patterns under a smooth amber finish. Its shaft gives a soft green glimmer when resting against healthy soil.

Gatekeeper's Halberd.name: Gatekeeper's Halberd
Gatekeeper's Halberd.description: A steel axe blade, hook and spear point mounted on a long square-cut shaft. Its reach makes it awkward company in a narrow room.

Freightyard Billhook.name: Freightyard Billhook
Freightyard Billhook.description: A sturdy hooked polearm built for controlling a close approach. The head is secured with two long reinforcing strips.

Silverstep Glaive.name: Silverstep Glaive
Silverstep Glaive.description: A long curved blade carried on a carefully tapered shaft. Silver wire at the grip records its balance points.

Windward Procession.name: Windward Procession
Windward Procession.description: A sweeping glaive with fine holes through its blade. Moving it in a practiced arc produces a low, clean chord and stirs the loose ribbons at its heel.

Woodcutter's Fighting Axe.name: Woodcutter's Fighting Axe
Woodcutter's Fighting Axe.description: A short, sharp axe with a reliable hickory haft and a head light enough for fighting. Its edge still handles ordinary camp work.

Notched Caravan Axe.name: Notched Caravan Axe
Notched Caravan Axe.description: A compact broad axe with a protective steel strip down the front of its haft. A small notch in the heel fits its travel cover.

Cairn-Splitter Axe.name: Cairn-Splitter Axe
Cairn-Splitter Axe.description: A heavy single-bit axe with a flared edge and a rough black haft. It is built for hard, committed blows.

Widow's Promise.name: Widow's Promise
Widow's Promise.description: A beautiful black axe with a white silk grip. Old repairs hold their shape poorly around it, and healers tend to move it away before beginning work.

Ironheaded Maul.name: Ironheaded Maul
Ironheaded Maul.description: A two-handed wooden haft carrying a plain iron head. The leather grip is thick enough to replace after a wet season.

Quarryman's Hammer.name: Quarryman's Hammer
Quarryman's Hammer.description: A compact war hammer with a reinforced haft and a narrow back spike. Its maker began as a quarry toolwright.

Thunderhead Sledge.name: Thunderhead Sledge
Thunderhead Sledge.description: A broad two-handed hammer with a dark steel face and a cord-wrapped lower grip. Every fitting is oversized and reassuringly plain.

The Uninvited Knock.name: The Uninvited Knock
The Uninvited Knock.description: A war maul with a polished brass striking face shaped like an expressionless door knocker. Its impact makes a deep, resonant report even against soft timber.

Plain Flanged Mace.name: Plain Flanged Mace
Plain Flanged Mace.description: A short steel mace with six blunt flanges and a leather wrist loop. The head has no decorative sharp edges to catch in its cover.

Whitepass Morningstar.name: Whitepass Morningstar
Whitepass Morningstar.description: A compact spiked mace with a strong winter grip. A fitted wooden cap protects everything else in the owner's pack.

Pilgrim's Iron Cudgel.name: Pilgrim's Iron Cudgel
Pilgrim's Iron Cudgel.description: An iron-shod hardwood club with a carved grip worn smooth by years of use. Its ornamental cord carries several repaired knots.

Bellringer's Courtesy.name: Bellringer's Courtesy
Bellringer's Courtesy.description: A hollow-headed mace whose internal tongue can be secured for travel. Unfastened, it lends a clear toll to a deliberately placed strike.

Yew Hunting Bow.name: Yew Hunting Bow
Yew Hunting Bow.description: A straightforward wooden bow with a waxed string and a simple leather grip. Arrows are carried separately.

Horn-Backed Recurve.name: Horn-Backed Recurve
Horn-Backed Recurve.description: A short recurve strengthened with horn and sinew. Its padded travel cover matters as much as its handsome finish.

Pinefold Longbow.name: Pinefold Longbow
Pinefold Longbow.description: A tall, patient bow made from seasoned mountain wood. The pale grip bears tiny marks used to check its string alignment.

The Far Green Silence.name: The Far Green Silence
The Far Green Silence.description: A longbow of translucent green wood with no visible maker's seam. A drawn string leaves the surrounding air peculiarly still until released.

Stockman's Crossbow.name: Stockman's Crossbow
Stockman's Crossbow.description: A plain wooden crossbow with an iron prod and a sturdy loading stirrup. Bolts are bought and carried separately.

Compact Lever Crossbow.name: Compact Lever Crossbow
Compact Lever Crossbow.description: A short crossbow with a folding lever for deliberate reloading. Its mechanism is accessible beneath a latched side plate.

Watchtower Arbalest.name: Watchtower Arbalest
Watchtower Arbalest.description: A heavy crossbow with a deeply braced stock and a slow, positive winding mechanism. It rewards choosing a position before the fight starts.

Clockwork Sparrow.name: Clockwork Sparrow
Clockwork Sparrow.description: A brass-trimmed crossbow whose little mechanical bird clicks when its ordinary bolt track is seated correctly. It is exacting about maintenance.

Ironshod Quarterstaff.name: Ironshod Quarterstaff
Ironshod Quarterstaff.description: A tough wooden fighting staff with iron caps and a plain central grip. Its strength comes from wood and sound construction.

Weighted Traveling Staff.name: Weighted Traveling Staff
Weighted Traveling Staff.description: A staff whose concealed internal weights give its ends a firm, predictable swing. A threaded cap allows repairs.

Ambercore Battlestaff.name: Ambercore Battlestaff
Ambercore Battlestaff.description: A durable fighting staff with a thin mana-bearing amber core. Its reinforced ends are intended for actual staff work.

The Rain-Hating Staff.name: The Rain-Hating Staff
The Rain-Hating Staff.description: A pale battlestaff whose upper cap unfolds into a broad waxed canopy. It drips collected rain with an indignant ticking sound.

Short Iron Chain.name: Short Iron Chain
Short Iron Chain.description: A short length of well-linked chain with reinforced hand loops. Using it carelessly is an excellent way to strike one's own knuckles.

Weighted Chainblade.name: Weighted Chainblade
Weighted Chainblade.description: A short blade joined to a balanced weight by a measured chain. Each end has a fitted travel restraint.

Twin-Hook Chain.name: Twin-Hook Chain
Twin-Hook Chain.description: A paired set of hooked blades joined by a robust chain, intended for a practiced two-handed method. A padded case keeps it civilized in transit.

Firefly Catenary.name: Firefly Catenary
Firefly Catenary.description: A dark chain weapon whose insulated grips frame fine yellow sparks beneath the link enamel. The sparks gather along its length during lightning workings.

Braided Fighting Whip.name: Braided Fighting Whip
Braided Fighting Whip.description: A weighted braided whip with a reinforced handle and a replaceable end. Its coiled cover is plain, thick leather.

Ribbonsteel Lash.name: Ribbonsteel Lash
Ribbonsteel Lash.description: A flexible lash reinforced with thin steel segments. It takes careful maintenance to keep the joints moving smoothly.

Barbed Silk Whip.name: Barbed Silk Whip
Barbed Silk Whip.description: A dark braided whip with short, deliberately spaced metal barbs. Its owner's gloves should be sturdier than its elegant handle suggests.

Violet Reprimand.name: Violet Reprimand
Violet Reprimand.description: A violet lash with silver stitching and a faint scent of cold flowers. The stitching brightens under a deliberately channeled enchantment.

Balanced Twinblade.name: Balanced Twinblade
Balanced Twinblade.description: Two short blades share a central grip wrapped for both hands. Its long travel case is as conspicuous as the weapon.

Brassguard Twinblade.name: Brassguard Twinblade
Brassguard Twinblade.description: A double-ended weapon with protective flared guards near its central grip. Brass grip bands make alignment easy to feel.

Snowwheel Twinblade.name: Snowwheel Twinblade
Snowwheel Twinblade.description: A compact twinblade with narrow blades and winterproof grip wrapping. A broad scabbard encloses both ends together.

The Blue Hour's Argument.name: The Blue Hour's Argument
The Blue Hour's Argument.description: A double-ended silver weapon whose opposing blades carry different blue reflections under the same light. Its grip bears an inscription worn beyond legibility.

Reinforced Fighting Gloves.name: Reinforced Fighting Gloves
Reinforced Fighting Gloves.description: Thick leather gloves with rigid knuckle plates and reinforced seams. They are meant for trained punches rather than delicate repairs.

Brassknuckle Wraps.name: Brassknuckle Wraps
Brassknuckle Wraps.description: A fitted pair of fighting wraps built around small brass knuckle guards. The palm remains flexible for grappling.

Stonebrace Gauntlets.name: Stonebrace Gauntlets
Stonebrace Gauntlets.description: Heavy articulated gauntlets with broad wrist supports. Small gaps at the joints keep a tightly closed fist from pinching.

Laughing Giant's Gloves.name: Laughing Giant's Gloves
Laughing Giant's Gloves.description: Oversized fighting gloves of enchanted hide. Their palms are surprisingly dexterous, but the weight is very noticeable during a nimble scramble.

Ironbound Round Shield.name: Ironbound Round Shield
Ironbound Round Shield.description: A wooden round shield with an iron rim and boss. A padded inner strap keeps the edge from battering the forearm.

Caravan Kite Shield.name: Caravan Kite Shield
Caravan Kite Shield.description: A long shield with a reinforced lower point and a faded trade-road pattern. Its repair-friendly construction suits repeated travel.

Riveted Tower Shield.name: Riveted Tower Shield
Riveted Tower Shield.description: A broad shield with a padded shoulder rest and a deep viewing notch. Its owner pays for the protection in carried weight.

The Door That Refused.name: The Door That Refused
The Door That Refused.description: An immense shield paneled like an old painted door, complete with a useless little brass knocker. Its hinges are ornamental; its weight is not.

Steel-Ribbed War Fan.name: Steel-Ribbed War Fan
Steel-Ribbed War Fan.description: A folding fan with blunt steel ribs and a secure central pin. Closed, it is a compact striking tool; open, it is unmistakably a weapon.

Painted Crane Fans.name: Painted Crane Fans
Painted Crane Fans.description: A matched pair of reinforced fans painted with red cranes. Their weighted ribs suit practiced turns as well as formal performance.

Mirrorleaf Battle Fan.name: Mirrorleaf Battle Fan
Mirrorleaf Battle Fan.description: A broad fan with polished metal leaves and a reinforced thumb rest. A cloth sheath protects the reflective finish.

Curtain Call in Gold.name: Curtain Call in Gold
Curtain Call in Gold.description: A gold-leafed war fan whose painted audience changes expressions as its folds move. The tiny figures never leave the painted stage.

Long-Haft War Scythe.name: Long-Haft War Scythe
Long-Haft War Scythe.description: A purpose-made fighting scythe with a straighter blade mounting than a farm tool. Its long haft demands two hands and room to turn.

Hooked Harvest Glaive.name: Hooked Harvest Glaive
Hooked Harvest Glaive.description: A long curved blade with an inward hook, fitted on a steel-braced wooden haft. Its removable cover is very carefully labeled.

Blackfield Reaper.name: Blackfield Reaper
Blackfield Reaper.description: A dark two-handed scythe with a stiff haft and a narrow crescent blade. Its maker has favored fighting balance over ornament.

The Undertaker's Compliment.name: The Undertaker's Compliment
The Undertaker's Compliment.description: A silver-gray war scythe with small bone-colored ceramic beads hanging beneath its blade. The beads give a low chord near an active spiritual working.

Padded Traveling Cap.name: Padded Traveling Cap
Padded Traveling Cap.description: A close-fitting quilted cap with ear flaps that tie beneath the chin. It packs flat and dries beside a modest fire.

Plain Steel Helm.name: Plain Steel Helm
Plain Steel Helm.description: An open-faced steel helmet with a replaceable padded liner. The brow is deliberately free of decorative projections.

Caravan Sallet.name: Caravan Sallet
Caravan Sallet.description: A low steel helmet with a broad, carefully placed viewing opening. Its long rear protects the neck without a cumbersome collar.

Glassworker's Hood.name: Glassworker's Hood
Glassworker's Hood.description: A thick hood with a clear hinged face screen and a soft internal band. Soot wipes easily from its smooth surface.

Pinefold Hunting Hood.name: Pinefold Hunting Hood
Pinefold Hunting Hood.description: A lined green hood with a weathered outer surface and discreet loops for local foliage. Its heavy hem stays down in a crosswind.

Star-Pinned Scholar's Hat.name: Star-Pinned Scholar's Hat
Star-Pinned Scholar's Hat.description: A soft pointed hat whose small silver star is actually a neatly caged mana crystal. Its brim can be buttoned out of the wearer's eyes.

Stormreader's Goggles.name: Stormreader's Goggles
Stormreader's Goggles.description: Brass goggles with adjustable blue lenses that make fine electrical traces easier to distinguish. Old scratches remain visible in the left lens.

Ashen Diadem.name: Ashen Diadem
Ashen Diadem.description: A black metal circlet warm at the temples. Its red stones brighten around flames while medicinal enchantments feel unusually stubborn nearby.

The Crown of Small Complaints.name: The Crown of Small Complaints
The Crown of Small Complaints.description: A thin silver crown ornamented with tiny closed mouths. In quiet rooms its wearer hears indistinct muttering, usually about matters of astonishing triviality.

Quilted Field Coat.name: Quilted Field Coat
Quilted Field Coat.description: A tough padded coat with a slit hem and broad inner pockets. The stitching is plain, close and easy to repair.

Leather Brigandine.name: Leather Brigandine
Leather Brigandine.description: A leather outer coat carrying small steel plates beneath its lining. Its buckles can be worked with cold fingers.

Plain Mail Shirt.name: Plain Mail Shirt
Plain Mail Shirt.description: A long steel mail shirt with leather bindings at the neck and sleeves. A padded underlayer makes its weight much more agreeable.

Rivet-and-Rime Cuirass.name: Rivet-and-Rime Cuirass
Rivet-and-Rime Cuirass.description: A carefully fitted steel breastplate with fur-backed straps and brass rivets. Mountain armorers leave room for a practical winter layer.

Surveyor's Long Vest.name: Surveyor's Long Vest
Surveyor's Long Vest.description: A sturdy sleeveless field vest with numbered specimen pockets and a narrow waterproof notebook sleeve. Its shoulders are reinforced for carrying straps.

Rainleaf Caster's Coat.name: Rainleaf Caster's Coat
Rainleaf Caster's Coat.description: A dark green coat whose treated cloth beads rain into tidy lines. Fine blue stitching follows the cuffs and shoulder seams.

Mirror-Sewn Robe.name: Mirror-Sewn Robe
Mirror-Sewn Robe.description: A flowing robe with tiny polished discs hidden in its hems. As its wearer moves, the cloth catches slightly misplaced glints of light.

Glassheart Cuirass.name: Glassheart Cuirass
Glassheart Cuirass.description: A clear crystal breastplate fitted around a milky central stone. Its cool pressure makes the wearer feel strangely fragile beneath the formidable shell.

Emberrest Mantle-Coat.name: Emberrest Mantle-Coat
Emberrest Mantle-Coat.description: A thick red traveling coat with charcoal-black seams. Its lining keeps a comfortable warmth long after the wearer leaves the hearth.

The Quiet Citadel.name: The Quiet Citadel
The Quiet Citadel.description: A dark cuirass made from interlocking plates finer than ordinary smiths can reliably reproduce. Its tiny joints close with a sound like a distant latch.

Hardwearing Field Trousers.name: Hardwearing Field Trousers
Hardwearing Field Trousers.description: Stout trousers with patched knees and a gusseted seat. Their owner can kneel on rough ground without immediately regretting it.

Leather Greaves.name: Leather Greaves
Leather Greaves.description: Boiled-leather leg guards lined with felt. The straps are broad enough to distribute pressure during a long walk.

Articulated Steel Greaves.name: Articulated Steel Greaves
Articulated Steel Greaves.description: Steel knee and shin guards with overlapping joints. A small maker's mark identifies the left piece when they are laid out for cleaning.

Climber's Split Skirt.name: Climber's Split Skirt
Climber's Split Skirt.description: A reinforced divided overskirt with secure ties and a narrow inner pocket. The hem stays out of a climber's knee bend.

Woolridge Winter Leggings.name: Woolridge Winter Leggings
Woolridge Winter Leggings.description: Heavy wool leggings with a close windproof outer weave. Replaceable straps keep them from riding above a winter boot.

Duelist's Silver Seams.name: Duelist's Silver Seams
Duelist's Silver Seams.description: Close-fitting dark trousers traced with flexible silver stitching at the knees and hips. They are much less delicate than their formal appearance suggests.

Rootbound Chausses.name: Rootbound Chausses
Rootbound Chausses.description: Soft mail leggings whose green fastenings resemble tightly closed buds. Soil caught in the weave falls free with a firm shake.

The Heavy Road.name: The Heavy Road
The Heavy Road.description: Dark traveling leggings with strangely dense hems. Their wearer can sustain a burden for longer but quickly notices the weight when trying to leap.

Leather Road Boots.name: Leather Road Boots
Leather Road Boots.description: High leather boots with replaceable laces and sound soles. Their appearance improves considerably after a brush and a little oil.

Hobnailed Working Boots.name: Hobnailed Working Boots
Hobnailed Working Boots.description: Thick boots with iron hobnails and reinforced toes. On polished floors they announce their owner well before the conversation starts.

Whitepass Snow Boots.name: Whitepass Snow Boots
Whitepass Snow Boots.description: Fur-lined boots with deep tread and leather covers over the lacing. The removable felt liners dry overnight near a hearth.

Quietstep Soft Boots.name: Quietstep Soft Boots
Quietstep Soft Boots.description: Soft-soled boots with carefully padded seams and no loose fittings. The leather is dull rather than artificially black.

Iron-Toed Duel Boots.name: Iron-Toed Duel Boots
Iron-Toed Duel Boots.description: Balanced leather boots with small steel toe caps and close ankle supports. Their soles turn predictably on a clean practice floor.

Ladderkeeper's Boots.name: Ladderkeeper's Boots
Ladderkeeper's Boots.description: Work boots with firm arches and a squared heel that rests securely on a rung. The maker has reinforced every point touched by a climbing strap.

Cloudtread Slippers.name: Cloudtread Slippers
Cloudtread Slippers.description: Pale slippers woven with soft sky-fiber. Their soles briefly display tiny cloud shapes after each step on a cold surface.

Moss-Mannered Boots.name: Moss-Mannered Boots
Moss-Mannered Boots.description: Brown boots with living-looking moss tucked beneath their laces. The little green fronds curl inward when the boots are polished.

The Impatient Heels.name: The Impatient Heels
The Impatient Heels.description: Elegant boots whose heels tap a brisk rhythm when their wearer stands still. Performers argue whether the habit is charming or infuriating.

Gravelfall Sabatons.name: Gravelfall Sabatons
Gravelfall Sabatons.description: Steel foot guards with dark violet stones set inside the ankle joints. Their weight seems to settle evenly over whatever surface bears them.

Plain Work Gloves.name: Plain Work Gloves
Plain Work Gloves.description: A practical pair of thick leather gloves with replaceable palms. Fine needlework is possible, but not pleasant.

Supple Archery Gloves.name: Supple Archery Gloves
Supple Archery Gloves.description: Close-fitting gloves with smooth fingers and a reinforced drawing hand. Their seams are kept away from a bowstring.

Riveted Winter Gauntlets.name: Riveted Winter Gauntlets
Riveted Winter Gauntlets.description: Articulated gauntlets with warm liners and oversized strap ends. A mitten cover can be pulled over them between fights.

Alchemist's Waxed Gloves.name: Alchemist's Waxed Gloves
Alchemist's Waxed Gloves.description: Close gloves with a treated outer surface and long cuffs. Their stitching is easy to inspect for the damage a careless experiment leaves behind.

Fine Mechanist's Gloves.name: Fine Mechanist's Gloves
Fine Mechanist's Gloves.description: Thin work gloves with grippy fingertips and small removable steel bracers. Their owner can feel a loose screw through the palm.

Mercywork Gloves.name: Mercywork Gloves
Mercywork Gloves.description: Cream-colored gloves stitched with delicate red thread. The fingers retain their sensitivity even after repeated washing.

Touch of the Distant Forge.name: Touch of the Distant Forge
Touch of the Distant Forge.description: Black gloves with copper seams that glow faintly while metal is being worked. Their fingertips smell of warm iron even after cleaning.

Thorn-Bitten Gloves.name: Thorn-Bitten Gloves
Thorn-Bitten Gloves.description: Green gloves whose fine seams occasionally press like tiny thorns. A dry rose is embroidered across each palm.

Plain Wool Cloak.name: Plain Wool Cloak
Plain Wool Cloak.description: A heavy wool cloak with a reliable wooden clasp. It does what a traveler expects and makes no claims beyond that.

Waxed Rain Cape.name: Waxed Rain Cape
Waxed Rain Cape.description: A broad cape of waxed cloth with a deep hood. Rain gathers in its folded hem if the wearer forgets to shake it out.

Snowchain Freight Cloak.name: Snowchain Freight Cloak
Snowchain Freight Cloak.description: A thick cloak cut short enough to clear pack straps and haul lines. A red lining makes it visible in bad mountain weather.

Greenblind Shoulder Cape.name: Greenblind Shoulder Cape
Greenblind Shoulder Cape.description: A mottled shoulder cape with a hood that breaks up the outline of the face. Its colors suit woodland rather than every conceivable background.

Keeper's Tool Mantle.name: Keeper's Tool Mantle
Keeper's Tool Mantle.description: A reinforced mantle with narrow loops for a few carefully fastened tools. Its weight lies across the shoulders instead of pulling at the neck.

Night-Lantern Cloak.name: Night-Lantern Cloak
Night-Lantern Cloak.description: A dark cloak dotted with small luminous threads inside the hood. The wearer can cover or expose them by turning its edge.

Borrowed Breeze Cape.name: Borrowed Breeze Cape
Borrowed Breeze Cape.description: A light cape whose corners seem perpetually interested in the nearest breeze. Its clasp is a tiny pair of folded brass wings.

The Cloak That Sulks.name: The Cloak That Sulks
The Cloak That Sulks.description: A charcoal cloak that draws itself into unflattering folds when displayed for admiration. In a quiet corner it hangs perfectly.

Hearth Away From Home.name: Hearth Away From Home
Hearth Away From Home.description: A heavy red travel cloak with a soft amber lining. Even in an unfamiliar shelter, it carries a faint scent of dry wood and clean wool.

Copper Grip Ring.name: Copper Grip Ring
Copper Grip Ring.description: A thick copper ring with a rough inner ridge. Porters turn the ridge toward the palm before taking a difficult grip.

Brass Scholar's Ring.name: Brass Scholar's Ring
Brass Scholar's Ring.description: A plain brass ring carrying a tiny hinged lens. The lens folds out neatly over a page or small fitting.

Amber Spark Ring.name: Amber Spark Ring
Amber Spark Ring.description: A warm amber chip sits in a copper band. A narrow gold seam makes the stone look as though it contains one small ember.

Rainmark Ring.name: Rainmark Ring
Rainmark Ring.description: A silver band carrying a blue stone with a persistent waterline across its middle. The line shifts when the ring is turned.

Pebble-Crowned Ring.name: Pebble-Crowned Ring
Pebble-Crowned Ring.description: A simple iron ring set with an unpolished gray pebble. Fine pale veins circle it like miniature strata.

Tumbling Feather Ring.name: Tumbling Feather Ring
Tumbling Feather Ring.description: A small feather is suspended within a clear setting. It turns lazily whenever a fresh breeze reaches the ring.

Storm-Nail Ring.name: Storm-Nail Ring
Storm-Nail Ring.description: A dark steel ring with a single yellow inclusion. When rubbed clean, its surface briefly smells of a summer storm.

Thawglass Ring.name: Thawglass Ring
Thawglass Ring.description: A clear blue ring cold enough to mist in warm air. Its interior looks cracked, though the smooth stone has no loose edge.

Sunpin Ring.name: Sunpin Ring
Sunpin Ring.description: A gold setting frames a tiny pale crystal. The crystal holds the last color of daylight for several minutes after sunset.

The Crooked Halo.name: The Crooked Halo
The Crooked Halo.description: A slightly tilted golden ring that looks straight only from an unflattering angle. Its pale radiance makes a practiced innocent expression difficult to sustain.

The Ring That Applauds.name: The Ring That Applauds
The Ring That Applauds.description: A silver ring etched with tiny hands. When tapped twice against a hard surface it answers with a brief, rather enthusiastic patter.

The Patient Orbit.name: The Patient Orbit
The Patient Orbit.description: A violet stone moves slowly around this open ring without touching its metal. Its orbit remains stubbornly unchanged by the wearer's attempts to hurry it.

Wooden Road Pendant.name: Wooden Road Pendant
Wooden Road Pendant.description: A small carved road marker on a sturdy cord. The back is flat enough to write a name and an address.

Iron Needle Pendant.name: Iron Needle Pendant
Iron Needle Pendant.description: A short iron needle hangs inside an open silver frame. It takes a controlled metallic working to turn it precisely without contact.

Greenhouse Heart.name: Greenhouse Heart
Greenhouse Heart.description: A clear pendant holding a tiny living sprig. It needs an occasional drop of clean water and resents being left in a hot drawer.

Bronze Listener.name: Bronze Listener
Bronze Listener.description: A hollow bronze bead hangs on a short chain. Humming near it produces a warm vibration under the fingers.

Mercyseed Locket.name: Mercyseed Locket
Mercyseed Locket.description: A white ceramic locket with space for a small pressed leaf or personal note. Its polished surface warms in a healer's hand.

Open-Circle Medallion.name: Open-Circle Medallion
Open-Circle Medallion.description: A silver circle interrupted by one deliberate gap. Tiny ceramic figures have been worked into the edge, all facing outward.

Glass Moth Pendant.name: Glass Moth Pendant
Glass Moth Pendant.description: A blue glass moth with thin silver antennae. Its wing patterns appear different in a reflection, though the glass itself never moves.

Three-Question Amulet.name: Three-Question Amulet
Three-Question Amulet.description: Three small colored stones are set beneath a hinged cover. Old diviners polish one stone before each difficult question.

Black-Salt Charm.name: Black-Salt Charm
Black-Salt Charm.description: A black crystal sealed in a narrow silver cage. Loose dust gathers around its frame in sharp, orderly lines.

Ferryman's Copper.name: Ferryman's Copper
Ferryman's Copper.description: A weathered copper disc on a dark cord, stamped with an empty little boat. Its surface gives a faint note when brushed during a spiritual working.

Glutton's Clasp.name: Glutton's Clasp
Glutton's Clasp.description: A heavy pendant shaped like a smiling open mouth. Its wearer feels brimming with magical capacity and unreasonably tired after climbing stairs.

The Smallest North.name: The Smallest North
The Smallest North.description: A silver compass pendant whose needle circles a point just outside its case. Its maker's diagram is engraved so finely that magnification is needed to read it.

First-Shift Brooch.name: First-Shift Brooch
First-Shift Brooch.description: A little brass shopfront pin with a replaceable name strip. The clasp is stronger than its cheerful appearance suggests.

Quiet Courtesy Pin.name: Quiet Courtesy Pin
Quiet Courtesy Pin.description: A small silver pin finished so smoothly that it never catches a formal sleeve. Its shape resembles a carefully folded greeting card.

Tailor's Little Moon.name: Tailor's Little Moon
Tailor's Little Moon.description: A crescent-shaped brooch engraved with tiny stitch marks. Its curved backing rests flat against a lined collar.

Ruby Field Pin.name: Ruby Field Pin
Ruby Field Pin.description: A practical ruby-red marker pin with a strong double clasp. Mapmakers use its shape as a reference when sketching a position.

The Modest Peacock.name: The Modest Peacock
The Modest Peacock.description: A splendid peacock brooch whose metal feathers fold inward when someone tries to spread them. It looks most dignified when left alone.

Jester's Honest Face.name: Jester's Honest Face
Jester's Honest Face.description: A tiny enamel mask changes from a grin to an embarrassed frown when turned upside down. Its owner tends to become a little too expressive.

Pressed-Fern Brooch.name: Pressed-Fern Brooch
Pressed-Fern Brooch.description: A real fern has been sealed between two clear plates. Small scratches in the silver frame suggest long use in a working conservatory.

The Listening Widow.name: The Listening Widow
The Listening Widow.description: A silver spider brooch whose slender legs vibrate with nearby sound. It makes surrounding details easy to notice and remarkably difficult to disregard.

Kitchen Laureate's Pin.name: Kitchen Laureate's Pin
Kitchen Laureate's Pin.description: A small golden spoon crossed with a flowering sprig. The stem smells faintly of warm citrus after it is polished.

The Empty Audience.name: The Empty Audience
The Empty Audience.description: A black enamel theater pin with seats too tiny to count easily. When warmed in the hand, it carries the distant hush just before a performance begins.

Plain Load Belt.name: Plain Load Belt
Plain Load Belt.description: A broad leather belt with a dependable brass buckle. Its back is padded where a heavy strap tends to rub.

Climber's Waist Strap.name: Climber's Waist Strap
Climber's Waist Strap.description: A stout belt with reinforced attachment loops and a buckle that can be checked by touch. It suits careful use with actual climbing equipment.

Quick-Pocket Belt.name: Quick-Pocket Belt
Quick-Pocket Belt.description: A close-fitting belt with shallow secured pockets. Its owner can kneel or roll without loose contents banging together.

Field Medic's Belt.name: Field Medic's Belt
Field Medic's Belt.description: A cleanable belt with labeled loops for actual medical supplies. Its empty pouches are conspicuous after a busy day's work.

Seven-Notch Gunmetal Belt.name: Seven-Notch Gunmetal Belt
Seven-Notch Gunmetal Belt.description: A gray belt with a heavy reinforced buckle and broad waist support. Seven small scratches mark an old adjustment point.

The Breath Between Hills.name: The Breath Between Hills
The Breath Between Hills.description: A supple green belt that smells of rain on grass. Its buckle is carved as a traveler resting against a milestone.

Pilgrim's Comfortable Burden.name: Pilgrim's Comfortable Burden
Pilgrim's Comfortable Burden.description: A broad belt with two small polished stones sealed inside its lining. The stones pull at the waist during a jump but settle pleasantly during a long walk.

Coincounter's Belt.name: Coincounter's Belt
Coincounter's Belt.description: A leather belt with a small mechanical counting wheel beside its purse loop. The wheel clicks to zero when the buckle is opened.

Lucky Button Cord.name: Lucky Button Cord
Lucky Button Cord.description: A bright assortment of buttons on a braided cord. Someone has sewn a smiling face onto the least valuable one.

Surveyor's Marker Charm.name: Surveyor's Marker Charm
Surveyor's Marker Charm.description: A flat enamel marker with a numbered rotating disc. The back has a narrow groove for a pencil rubbing.

Rosewater Knot.name: Rosewater Knot
Rosewater Knot.description: A neatly tied ribbon charm around a tiny reusable scent bead. Its little stopper is secured by a very fine chain.

Companion's Paw Token.name: Companion's Paw Token
Companion's Paw Token.description: A smooth wooden token shaped like a resting paw. Chew marks suggest that an earlier owner tested its durability thoroughly.

The Patient Pawn.name: The Patient Pawn
The Patient Pawn.description: A small weighted chess pawn on a short chain. Its base is broad enough to stand on a map without falling over.

Root-and-Rivet Token.name: Root-and-Rivet Token
Root-and-Rivet Token.description: A wooden charm held together with visible brass rivets. A tiny shoot follows the joining seam without splitting the wood.

Moonlit Mortar Charm.name: Moonlit Mortar Charm
Moonlit Mortar Charm.description: A pale stone charm shaped like a miniature mortar. Its bowl darkens when stained and lightens again after a careful cleaning.

Second Thought Talisman.name: Second Thought Talisman
Second Thought Talisman.description: A blue stone carved into a small open hand. It is soothing to hold and lends a decidedly hesitant air to a dramatic threat.

The Unfinished Equation.name: The Unfinished Equation
The Unfinished Equation.description: A metal tag engraved with a geometric proof that stops just before its final line. Its blank lower edge is polished by worried thumbs.

Bellwind Promise Cord.name: Bellwind Promise Cord
Bellwind Promise Cord.description: A braided cord carrying a soft wooden bell. Its tongue can be tied still before approaching a nervous creature.

The Unpaid Tab.name: The Unpaid Tab
The Unpaid Tab.description: A bronze tavern token whose tally lines rearrange whenever it is polished. Bartenders often take an immediate dislike to it.

Grave-Courtesy Beads.name: Grave-Courtesy Beads
Grave-Courtesy Beads.description: A strand of gray ceramic beads with one empty place in the sequence. Their soft clicking is often used to keep a spiritual working measured.

Birch Practice Wand.name: Birch Practice Wand
Birch Practice Wand.description: A short mana-bearing birch wand with a plain linen grip. Its light weight suits careful introductory control.

Amber-Nib Wand.name: Amber-Nib Wand
Amber-Nib Wand.description: A slender wand ending in a protected amber nib. Its owner can trace a familiar pattern with very little pressure.

Bronze Conductor's Baton.name: Bronze Conductor's Baton
Bronze Conductor's Baton.description: A polished baton weighted at the heel, with a bronze ring around its tip. Its hollow handle gives a clear reference note.

Rootglass Casting Wand.name: Rootglass Casting Wand
Rootglass Casting Wand.description: A green glass wand enclosing a fine branching root. The root is visible from every angle and has never grown beyond its original outline.

Folded-Lecture Grimoire.name: Folded-Lecture Grimoire
Folded-Lecture Grimoire.description: A compact grimoire with foldout geometric plates and a tough mana-bearing binding. Blank leaves remain for its owner's corrections.

Cloudfield Observation Atlas.name: Cloudfield Observation Atlas
Cloudfield Observation Atlas.description: A waterproof field atlas with ruled pages for cloud forms, distances and weather signs. Its maps cover established routes rather than every island.

Bone-Handled Medical Lancet.name: Bone-Handled Medical Lancet
Bone-Handled Medical Lancet.description: A small, carefully sharpened medical instrument in a lined case. The bone handle has enough texture to grip with wet fingers.

Coppercoil Focus.name: Coppercoil Focus
Coppercoil Focus.description: An insulated hand focus containing a neatly wound copper coil. Small inspection windows expose the state of its fittings.

Portable Mana Gauge.name: Portable Mana Gauge
Portable Mana Gauge.description: A sturdy dial instrument for comparing local magical activity. Its reading needs interpretation and a checked reference point.

Folding Brass Astrolabe.name: Folding Brass Astrolabe
Folding Brass Astrolabe.description: A small astrolabe with nested rings and an unusually clear horizon scale. Its leather case is covered in old alignment marks.

Surveyor's North Compass.name: Surveyor's North Compass
Surveyor's North Compass.description: A dependable magnetic compass with a simple sighting notch. Nearby metal can make its useful little needle thoroughly unhelpful.

Folding Map Board.name: Folding Map Board
Folding Map Board.description: A light wooden board with brass clamps and a foldout rule. It provides a flat writing surface on a very uncooperative rock.

Reusable Field Snare Set.name: Reusable Field Snare Set
Reusable Field Snare Set.description: A small set of wire snares, pegs and careful illustrated knots. The wires need resetting and inspection after actual use.

Covered Camping Brazier.name: Covered Camping Brazier
Covered Camping Brazier.description: A compact charcoal brazier with a wind cover and a stable folding stand. Its soot tray slides out for cleaning.

Cook's Traveling Roll.name: Cook's Traveling Roll
Cook's Traveling Roll.description: A cloth roll holding a small knife, spoon, flat scraper and nested measure. The little tools show years of sensible refinement.

Labeled Reagent Satchel.name: Labeled Reagent Satchel
Labeled Reagent Satchel.description: A padded satchel with snug compartments and replaceable specimen labels. Several pockets are clearly marked for empty containers.

Portable Copper Still.name: Portable Copper Still
Portable Copper Still.description: A compact still with well-fitted tubes and a stable stand. Its little pressure vent deserves attention rather than admiration.

Mechanist's Repair Roll.name: Mechanist's Repair Roll
Mechanist's Repair Roll.description: A complete roll of fine drivers, probes and gripping tools. Every recess has a small outline showing where the missing tool belongs.

Spring-Grip Casting Tongs.name: Spring-Grip Casting Tongs
Spring-Grip Casting Tongs.description: Long tongs with a positive spring catch and insulated handles. The jaws hold a small piece steady during a controlled working.

Perfumer's Traveling Case.name: Perfumer's Traveling Case
Perfumer's Traveling Case.description: A padded case of clean sample bottles, testing strips and small measures. Its lid carries a carefully made folding work surface.

Waterproof Courier Tube.name: Waterproof Courier Tube
Waterproof Courier Tube.description: A stout document tube with a screw cap and an inner waxed sleeve. Its shoulder cord has been tested with more weight than paper.

Silver Reservoir Pen.name: Silver Reservoir Pen
Silver Reservoir Pen.description: A long silver pen with a fine mana-bearing tip and an ordinary refillable ink reservoir. A small window shows when the ink is running low.

Living-Specimen Wardbox.name: Living-Specimen Wardbox
Living-Specimen Wardbox.description: A ventilated carrying box with adjustable padded partitions and a gentle temperature charm. Its little latch can be opened from outside only.

Three-Note Handler's Whistle.name: Three-Note Handler's Whistle
Three-Note Handler's Whistle.description: A brass whistle with three plainly marked stops. Its notes are consistent enough for a patiently trained animal to distinguish.

Magitech Voice Trumpet.name: Magitech Voice Trumpet
Magitech Voice Trumpet.description: A compact black voice amplifier with a silver grille and a comfortable hand strap. A small mana-fed resonator projects the speaker's actual voice.

Stitchkeeper's Focus Spool.name: Stitchkeeper's Focus Spool
Stitchkeeper's Focus Spool.description: A metal spool framing a thin mana-bearing thread. The spool turns smoothly enough to follow a measured casting gesture.

Long-Reach Reading Lens.name: Long-Reach Reading Lens
Long-Reach Reading Lens.description: A clear lens on a hinged arm that clamps to a table or board. Its broad focus is kind to tired eyes.

Nurse's Hooded Lamp.name: Nurse's Hooded Lamp
Nurse's Hooded Lamp.description: A carefully shaded lamp that throws a steady, warm pool of light without shining into the patient's eyes. Its handle stays cool.

Glassfish Lantern.name: Glassfish Lantern
Glassfish Lantern.description: A clear fish-shaped lantern with a little luminous bead drifting inside. The bead settles into its tail when the shutter is closed.

The Mapmaker's Unfolding Frame.name: The Mapmaker's Unfolding Frame
The Mapmaker's Unfolding Frame.description: A brass plotting frame with more hinged sections than fit comfortably inside its case. Every exposed scale remains perfectly aligned. It is a tool for interpreting real observations, not a map of unknown countries.

Mana Crystal Chips.name: Mana Crystal Chips
Mana Crystal Chips.description: A small paper packet of sorted mana-bearing crystal chips. The pieces are useful in modest fittings, repairs and experiments.

Clean Amber Sliver.name: Clean Amber Sliver
Clean Amber Sliver.description: A clear amber sliver wrapped in soft cloth. Its long unbroken grain makes it useful for a carefully sized magical component.

Coldglass Shard.name: Coldglass Shard
Coldglass Shard.description: A pale, translucent mineral shard whose surface stays cool after being held. Small flaws need checking before it is cut for a focus.

Prepared Wyvern Tendon.name: Prepared Wyvern Tendon
Prepared Wyvern Tendon.description: A treated length of tough wyvern tendon, cleaned and stretched for craft work. The wrapping records the batch and preparation date.

Old Dragon Scale.name: Old Dragon Scale
Old Dragon Scale.description: A weathered fragment of naturally shed dragon scale mounted in a respectful padded case. Its surface retains a deep mineral sheen, and its provenance matters to Drakenspire buyers.

Sky-Silk Thread Bundle.name: Sky-Silk Thread Bundle
Sky-Silk Thread Bundle.description: A small bundle of strong, pale thread collected and prepared through established Asterveil trade. It takes dye surprisingly well.

Singing Basalt Core.name: Singing Basalt Core
Singing Basalt Core.description: A fist-sized dark stone with a narrow resonant seam. A light tap produces a clean note that fades before the next breath.

Crystal Moth Wing.name: Crystal Moth Wing
Crystal Moth Wing.description: A carefully preserved moth wing with fine crystalline veins. Its fragile surface scatters light into small, sharply separated bands.

Dewglass Resin Cake.name: Dewglass Resin Cake
Dewglass Resin Cake.description: A small cake of clear, mature resin cut into a lined tin. When gently warmed, its internal haze separates into fine sparkling strands.

Grave-Salt Packet.name: Grave-Salt Packet
Grave-Salt Packet.description: A sealed packet of dry mineral salts prepared for particular spiritual workings. Its printed label lists the batch rather than promising a cure for every haunting.

Sealed Storm Residue.name: Sealed Storm Residue
Sealed Storm Residue.description: A little insulated vessel containing volatile stormglass residue. Blue flickers crawl beneath the cap when it is disturbed; its brittle seal deserves careful handling.

Dried Mooncap Slices.name: Dried Mooncap Slices
Dried Mooncap Slices.description: A small jar of properly dried pale mushroom slices. The faint violet gills remain visible through the glass.

Key Without Teeth.name: Key Without Teeth
Key Without Teeth.description: A beautifully made brass key with a perfectly smooth blade. Its bow is worn as though someone once used it every day.
Key Without Teeth.mediaContent: The maker's mark beneath the bow resembles three nested houses. The blade shows wear despite having no visible teeth.

Bottle of Unfinished Rain.name: Bottle of Unfinished Rain
Bottle of Unfinished Rain.description: A stoppered bottle in which a tiny rain cloud hangs above a shallow pool. The drops stop just short of the water and begin again when the bottle is turned.
Bottle of Unfinished Rain.mediaContent: A faded label reads: KEEP UPRIGHT UNTIL THE WEATHER MAKES UP ITS MIND.

The Tin King of Mice.name: The Tin King of Mice
The Tin King of Mice.description: A palm-sized clockwork mouse wearing a crooked tin crown. Winding its key makes it march a short, determined circle.
The Tin King of Mice.mediaContent: A small brass plate identifies it as His Very Temporary Majesty, ruler of the space beneath the nearest cupboard.

Unsigned Winter Letter.name: Unsigned Winter Letter
Unsigned Winter Letter.description: A folded letter sealed in pale blue wax, its recipient's name rubbed away by handling. The paper carries a faint scent of pine smoke.
Unsigned Winter Letter.mediaContent: I waited by the warm stair until the lamps were lit. If the route opens, leave a white thread at the place we agreed. I have kept the small thing you asked me to return.

Pocket of Quiet Shell.name: Pocket of Quiet Shell
Pocket of Quiet Shell.description: A closed white shell wrapped in soft leather. Held to the ear, it carries the gentle sounds of a shore quite unlike the nearby room.
Pocket of Quiet Shell.mediaContent: A scratched inscription inside the leather cover reads: For the days when the harbor is too far away.

The Button That Never Matches.name: The Button That Never Matches
The Button That Never Matches.description: A handsome coat button that always seems a slightly different shade from the cloth beside it. It has an entirely ordinary sewing loop.
The Button That Never Matches.mediaContent: Several tiny repair marks suggest a long sequence of owners trying it on a different coat.

Wax Seal of the Empty House.name: Wax Seal of the Empty House
Wax Seal of the Empty House.description: An old bronze seal bearing a house with no doors. Its impressions remain crisp even when the metal feels oddly cold.
Wax Seal of the Empty House.mediaContent: The underside of the handle carries a worn inventory number and the words RETURN AFTER VIEWING.

The Patient Paper Bird.name: The Patient Paper Bird
The Patient Paper Bird.description: A folded paper bird reinforced with fine thread. Its head bows once when placed on a warm palm, then waits without attempting to fly.
The Patient Paper Bird.mediaContent: A tiny handwritten note beneath one wing says: You need not answer immediately.

Pebble of Polite Disagreement.name: Pebble of Polite Disagreement
Pebble of Polite Disagreement.description: A smooth gray pebble that gives a soft, disapproving click when placed on another person's desk. It becomes completely silent inside a pocket.
Pebble of Polite Disagreement.mediaContent: A previous owner has written PLEASE DO NOT USE DURING MEETINGS on its little felt pouch.

The Last Unlit Lantern.name: The Last Unlit Lantern
The Last Unlit Lantern.description: An ornate lantern whose wick has never accepted flame. Its interior glass carries a different pattern of fine scratches on each side, as though a very patient hand once worked from within.
The Last Unlit Lantern.mediaContent: The maker's plate is blank. A careful examination finds no hidden hinge, spare fuel chamber or broken lighting mechanism.

Whalebone Dice Pair.name: Whalebone Dice Pair
Whalebone Dice Pair.description: Two old dice with tiny carved waves in place of dots. Their edges have been rounded by use, and one carries a repaired crack.
Whalebone Dice Pair.mediaContent: The inside of the box lists several games in different hands. The final line reads: Do not blame the sea for your arithmetic.

Mirror of the Absent Frame.name: Mirror of the Absent Frame
Mirror of the Absent Frame.description: A small hand mirror whose reflected frame has a missing corner, although the real silver frame is complete. Turning it produces no other apparent change.
Mirror of the Absent Frame.mediaContent: The back bears a neat repair record for a corner that does not seem to have been damaged.

Field Healing Tonic.name: Field Healing Tonic
Field Healing Tonic.description: A small bottle of sharp-tasting red tonic. Drinking one dose restores 15 Health; the empty bottle retains an unmistakable smell of bitter berries.

Greater Healing Draught.name: Greater Healing Draught
Greater Healing Draught.description: A carefully sealed deep-red preparation. Drinking one dose restores 60 Health. Its label recommends actual treatment for the cause of a serious injury.

Surgical Recovery Draught.name: Surgical Recovery Draught
Surgical Recovery Draught.description: A strong restorative medicine in a thick amber bottle. Drinking one dose restores 100 Health, without reversing a lasting condition or bringing back the dead.

Stable Mana Infusion.name: Stable Mana Infusion
Stable Mana Infusion.description: A regulated blue medicine with a mineral aftertaste. Drinking one dose restores 20 Mana. Its narrow-necked bottle is sized for a single measured serving.

Deep Mana Infusion.name: Deep Mana Infusion
Deep Mana Infusion.description: A concentrated, regulated mana medicine with pale sediment at its base. Drinking one carefully mixed dose restores 45 Mana.

Azure Reserve Dose.name: Azure Reserve Dose
Azure Reserve Dose.description: An expensive mana preparation held in a dark protective vial. Drinking one dose restores 70 Mana; the lingering taste is aggressively metallic.

Bitter Stamina Tonic.name: Bitter Stamina Tonic
Bitter Stamina Tonic.description: A squat bottle of brown tonic that tastes worse than it smells. Drinking one dose restores 12 Stamina.

Trail Vigor Draught.name: Trail Vigor Draught
Trail Vigor Draught.description: A mint-scented preparation sold in a padded traveling bottle. Drinking one dose restores 24 Stamina.

Last-Push Dose.name: Last-Push Dose
Last-Push Dose.description: A harsh stimulant with a bright warning stripe. Drinking one dose restores 40 Stamina but costs 8 Health; it leaves the throat raw and the hands uncomfortably warm.

Balanced Restoration Vial.name: Balanced Restoration Vial
Balanced Restoration Vial.description: A small violet preparation that separates into two clear layers. Shaken and drunk as one dose, it restores 20 Health and 12 Mana.

Amber Recovery Gel.name: Amber Recovery Gel
Amber Recovery Gel.description: A measured edible gel in a waxed sachet. Eating one serving restores 15 Health and 10 Stamina. It tastes insistently of honey and medicinal roots.

Redline Tincture.name: Redline Tincture
Redline Tincture.description: A dangerous crimson mana stimulant sold with an unmistakable warning. Drinking one dose restores 35 Mana but costs 15 Health.

Smoke Pearl.name: Smoke Pearl
Smoke Pearl.description: A brittle little sphere that releases a small cloud of dense gray smoke when crushed. The smoke spreads with the actual air and makes breathing near it unpleasant.

Squealing Pepper Salt.name: Squealing Pepper Salt
Squealing Pepper Salt.description: A packet of coarse pink seasoning that whistles faintly on hot food. A carelessly thrown pinch can make a nearby nose regret the experiment.

Weatherproofing Wax Tin.name: Weatherproofing Wax Tin
Weatherproofing Wax Tin.description: A small tin of practical wax for leather and treated cloth. One careful application covers a pair of boots or a similar small article.

Lantern-Moss Pellet.name: Lantern-Moss Pellet
Lantern-Moss Pellet.description: A pressed pellet of prepared luminous moss. Dampening it produces a gentle green light until the little mass dries and exhausts its stored glow.

Footprint Dust Packet.name: Footprint Dust Packet
Footprint Dust Packet.description: A pouch of very fine pale powder that catches on fresh damp traces. It is most useful on a surface the user can actually reach and inspect.

Clinging Resin Bottle.name: Clinging Resin Bottle
Clinging Resin Bottle.description: A tightly stoppered bottle of fast-setting adhesive. Its thick stream grips well against clean, suitable surfaces and poorly against loose dirt.

Frostbloom Powder.name: Frostbloom Powder
Frostbloom Powder.description: A sealed paper twist of cold-reactive powder. Scattered on a wet patch, it produces a short-lived crust of slick frost.

Stinkfrog Vial.name: Stinkfrog Vial
Stinkfrog Vial.description: A little green vial with a cork tied firmly in place. Opening it releases an appalling swamp smell that clings to porous cloth.

Self-Warming Bun.name: Self-Warming Bun
Self-Warming Bun.description: A soft spiced bun wrapped in heat-holding paper. Breaking its crust releases a pleasant little puff of warmth and the smell of cinnamon.

Honest Blue Candy.name: Honest Blue Candy
Honest Blue Candy.description: A little wrapped sweet that colors the eater's tongue an impressive blue for a while. The wrapper indignantly insists that this is the intended effect.

Pocket Celebration.name: Pocket Celebration
Pocket Celebration.description: A paper cone of harmless colored sparks, loose streamers and a startling pop. The little fuse burns long enough for a sensible person to hold it away from their face.

Resin Mending Patch.name: Resin Mending Patch
Resin Mending Patch.description: A sealed repair patch that softens when kneaded and hardens over a clean split. It is useful for a modest emergency repair to a compatible rigid object.
